inclusion: Speeches from 1993-03-13 (the election that seated the longest-serving current federal MP), at least 200 characters, deduplicated across overlapping sources, procedural rows removed (division roll-calls, chair interjections, day indexes). External statements require an official source URL, a valid date, an open licence, at least 200 characters and a unique body. News articles are excluded from ingestion and retrieval; headline links are external only.
known_defects: openaustralia-derived texts: roughly a quarter contain missing-space concatenation artefacts ('toSenator'); verify wording against the official record before quoting.
Member biographical linkage is unreliable for 151 members (~35K speeches); OPAX makes no members-derived biographical claims.
AEC donation disclosure: amounts under the indexed threshold are not reported; donation totals are a floor, not a ceiling.
SA Hansard stops at November 2024: hansardsearch.parliament.sa.gov.au now sits behind a WAF that challenges every non-browser request, so the source cannot be fetched.

source_limitations: SA Hansard refresh blocked by source HTTP 403; stored coverage ends 2024-11-12.
OpenAustralia has not yet supplied the 7-8 September sitting records; stored federal Hansard ends 2026-08-20.
